eidolons.name: Aether Editing: Eidolon +1
eidolons.desc:
Enemy targets in the Zone take 20% increased DMG.
When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, "Hidden MMR" will not be cleared. Instead, 20% of "Hidden MMR" will be retained.

eidolons.name: It's a Feature, Not a Bug
eidolons.desc: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, extends the duration of all buffs on this unit by 1 turn. In the current "Godmode Player" state, for every 120 point(s) of "Hidden MMR" increased (including the initial "Hidden MMR"), Silver Wolf LV.999 gains 1 extra turn and regains 1 use of Enhanced Basic ATK.

eidolons.name: Max Lv. 15? Says who?
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: I Came. I Saw. I One-Shot.
eidolons.desc: Elation DMG dealt by "Honkai-DMG Demo" additionally takes into account Punchline, equal to the original amount multiplied by 5.

eidolons.name: Basic ATK Is the New Ultimate
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Solo Maxxing!
eidolons.desc:
Elation DMG dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK merrymakes by 50%.
When enemy targets enter combat, they are implanted with "Absolute Weakness": Has All-Type Weakness, and reduces their All-Type Base RES to 0. (If Base RES is already at 0, then the corresponding Type RES decreases by 20% instead).

basic.name: One Punch!
basic.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {0}% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Trigger Happy
skill.desc: Gains 5 Punchline point(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to {0}% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK to all enemies.

ult.name: God Mode: ON!
ult.desc:
Enters the "Godmode Player" state, and advances action by 100%.
Deploys a Zone while in the "Godmode Player" state. While Silver Wolf LV.999 holds "Certified Banger," for every 1 Skill Point consumed by an ally target within the Zone, there is a chance to trigger 1 instance of Silver Wolf LV.999's "Top Loot Box": Deals {0}% Imaginary Elation DMG that is distributed evenly among all enemies, and randomly triggers 1 of the following effects:
"Big Flipping Sword": Additionally deals True DMG equal to 20% of the total DMG dealt this time to the enemy target with the highest HP.
"Kaboom Eggsplosion": Recovers 2 Skill Point(s).
"Funky Munch Bean": Gains 3 Punchline point(s).
The initial fixed chance to trigger the effect is 100%. After a successfully trigger, the fixed chance for the next trigger is reduced to 20% of the current chance. If the target is defeated before it triggers, it will instead trigger on a newly entering enemy target.

talent.name: I Carry, We Win
talent.desc:
After "Hidden MMR" reaches 60, can activate Ultimate. And after reaching its maximum limit, it can overflow by an additional 240 point(s).
When gaining Punchline, Silver Wolf LV.999 gains an equal amount of "Hidden MMR." Each point of "Hidden MMR" increases CRIT Rate by {1}%. Once CRIT Rate reaches 100%, each additional point of "Hidden MMR" instead increases CRIT DMG by {2}%.
While in the "Godmode Player" state, Silver Wolf LV.999 becomes immune to Crowd Control debuffs, cannot use Ultimate, and gains Enhanced Basic ATK and Enhanced Elation Skill. After fully using Enhanced Basic ATK 3 time(s), she exits the "Godmode Player" state. When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, clears "Hidden MMR".
While holding "Certified Banger," using Basic ATK or Skill deals {0}% Imaginary Elation DMG to the attacked enemy targets. And the Enhanced Basic ATK's ability DMG changes to Elation DMG at the same multiplier.

extra.name: Bonus Stage: αWolf Instant
extra.desc:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to a total of {0}% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK, split evenly into 100 hits that bounce onto random enemies. After every set number of bounces, the bouncing pauses and the Top Loot Box triggers 1 time. Can trigger up to 3 time(s) in total.
When dealing fatal damage to all enemies on the field, this ability ends. After attackable enemy targets appear, gains 1 extra turn and uses this ability again based on the remaining number of bounces and Top Loot Box triggers. The first time this effect triggers in each turn, extends the duration of all buffs on this unit by 1 turn.
After all of the above DMG is dealt, launches a Final Hit that deals Imaginary DMG equal to {1}% of Silver Wolf LV.999's ATK, split evenly among all enemies.
Enhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points. For every 60 points of "Hidden MMR" held, increases DMG dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK by 15% of the original DMG, stacking up to 2 time(s).

extra.name: Big Flipping Sword
extra.desc: Deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG to all enemies, split evenly among them. And deals True DMG to the target with the highest HP based on the total DMG dealt.

extra.name: Kaboom Eggsplosion
extra.desc: Deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG to all enemies, split evenly among them. And recovers Skill Points.

extra.name: Funky Munch Bean
extra.desc: Deals massive Imaginary Elation DMG to all enemies, split evenly among them. And gains Punchline.

extra.name: Honkai-DMG Demo
extra.desc: Deals 6 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing {0}% Imaginary Elation DMG to one random enemy. Then, resets the fixed chance to trigger "Top Loot Box" to its initial value.

extra.name: Faces of Elation ★ Holographic Mirage
extra.desc: When the Path of Elation ascends, "Hidden MMR" can overflow up to {0} after reaching its upper limit. Increases CRIT DMG by 40%. For every 1 point of "Party Trick" gained, simultaneously grants "Hidden MMR" equal to {1}% of that amount.

technique.name: This? Absolute Meta!
technique.desc:
Summons "Funky Munch Bean." Use again to dismiss. Using Technique does not consume Technique Points. When Technique Points reach 0, the summon is dismissed and Technique cannot be used.
"Funky Munch Bean" causes Normal Enemies within a certain range to enter a Terrified state. It will also automatically search for and attack Normal Enemies, consuming 1 Technique Point to instantly defeat them without entering combat.
While "Funky Munch Bean" is present, after entering combat, 1 instance of "Top Loot Box" from "Funky Munch Bean" is triggered at the start of each wave. A fixed amount of 99 "Certified Banger" is taken into account for the Elation DMG dealt in this instance.

ability_1.name: False Ending Speedrun
ability_1.desc: When SPD is 160 or higher, increases this unit's Elation by 50%. For every 1 SPD exceeded, increases this unit's Elation by 2%. Up to a max of 100 excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

ability_2.name: True Ending Unlocked
ability_2.desc: If the number of Punchline points taken into account when using Elation Skill is 20 or more, additionally gains 20 "Hidden MMR" points (And if it's 40 or more, then gains 20 more points on top of that).

ability_3.name: Secret Level Maxed
ability_3.desc: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, gains 20 "Hidden MMR" point(s).

lightCones.name: Welcome to the Cosmic City
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%/21%/24%/27%/30%. The Elation DMG dealt ignores 20%/24%/28%/32%/36% of the target's DEF. When the wearer uses Ultimate on themselves, gains 20/25/30/35/40 point(s) of "Punchline." This effect can be triggered up to 1 time. And resets this trigger count after using Basic ATK 3 time(s).

lightCones.name: A Little Getaway
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Elation by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. During the use of Elation Skill by the wearer, ignores 8%/10%/12%/14%/16% of the target's DEF.

lightCones.name: Today's Good Luck
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%, stacking up to 2 times.

lightCones.name: Mushy Shroomy's Adventures
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Elation by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by 6%/7%/8%/9%/10% for 2 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Tomorrow, Together
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases all allies' Elation by 8%/9%/10%/11%/12%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

relicSets.name: Ever-Glorious Magical Girl
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases CRIT DMG by 16%. 4-pc: The Elation DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprites ignores 10% of targets' DEF. For every 5 accumulated Punchline allies gain, the Elation DMG dealt additionally ignores 1% of targets' DEF, stacking up to 10 time(s).

relicSets.name: Diviner of Distant Reach
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases SPD by 6%. 4-pc: Before entering combat, if the wearer's SPD is greater than or equal to 120/160, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 10%/18%. When the wearer uses Elation Skill for the first time in each battle, increases all allies' Elation by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

planarSets.name: Punklorde Stage Zero
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Elation by 8%. When Elation reaches 40%/80% for the first time in combat, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 20%/32%.

planarSets.name: Izumo Gensei and Takama Divine Realm
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When entering battle, if at least one teammate follows the same Path as the wearer, then the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by 12%.

teams.name: Silver Wolf LV.999 Elation Team
teams.description: Two Elation damage dealers with Yao Guang's buffs and Pearl's healing. The Elation Trailblazer, Sparkle, Tribbie or Asta can replace Yao Guang, and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Hyacine or Huohuo can replace Pearl.

teams.name: Silver Wolf LV.999 F2P Team
teams.description: A cheaper Elation team with the free Elation Trailblazer and Asta.

lore.description: A new season of Elation begins, featuring the limited-time return of the invincible player "Silver Wolf LV.999"! She's conquered the universe, unlocked every cosmic achievement... What's left to play? "Reach the peak of 'Elation'? Boring... Since I've got the cartridge now, I make the rules~"
stories: >>>"I'll join." >>>And just like that, the game called "Punklorde" ended that day. >>>Admin "ID: Elio" granted access. >>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has joined the "Stellaron Hunters" faction, logging into the game "Cosmos." "Companion System" The girl used to be a lone wolf, but now she's got a few co-op allies: a lady with a 10.899 billion bounty on her head, and a guy and mech whose bounties are valued at 8.13 and 9.723 billion respectively. "You all look pretty solid. Just don't drag me down." She huffs and tosses a console each to all three. "Wanna play a round?" "Faction Buff" Mastermind? Laughter's mischief? "Come on. I don't mind being painted as the mastermind. Makes the game experience way more fun." With enemy fire raining down from behind, she snapped her fingers, and Silver Wolf's graffiti plastered itself all over the latest wanted posters. "Now try forgetting that. From now on, anytime someone mentions the Stellaron Hunters, they're immediately gonna think of Silver Wolf." "Main Missions" Administrator "ID: Elio" sets goals for the Hunters but doesn't restrict how they achieve them. In those worlds ravaged by Stellarons, she witnessed her allies' special abilities. "Toying with prey? Too elegant. I'm not that classy." "Can't die? No catch?" "Armor's here...I need a better-looking new set to play with too." She calls out to Elio, frustration in her voice: "Hey, everyone else gets all these perks, so why do I have to start the mission from scratch?" "WARNING" Warning! Stellaron Hunters collection storage has been breached! Warning! Top secret classified item, "Silver Wolf LV.999" Aether Cartridge has been stolen! "How can I steal something that was mine in the first place? Leaving!" The girl makes a face at the camera. Warning! Unauthorized use of the "Silver Wolf LV.999" Cartridge will result in unpredictable consequences! "As if... Just see how many ways of gameplay I can unlock with this!" >>>"ID: Silver Wolf" has logged out of "Cosmos" >>>"ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged in to "Cosmos" >>>Warning! Warning! Warning! >>>"Script" detected █████

"Backstage Paintball" was the first thing that came to her mind. You toss a ball into the screen here, and it flies out from another screen halfway across the cosmos. If a bunch of Masked Fools dared to feed her false intel and run their mouths... "Come at me through the internet if you've got the guts." ...she'd be more than happy to oblige their wish. That bomb could blow their local tavern sky-high. The "Formatting Gun" breaks down everything it touches into pixels, triggering a "shot" that formats all data. "If I want to uncover the true face of the Pure Child of Anāsrava, I'll need to be able to get out of the Garden of Recollection in one piece..." The girl imagined herself sneaking into the Garden, searching for clues... "I might as well format the Memokeepers' memories too! They'll definitely be standing there stunned, watching me slip away like I'm a total stranger!" "Greedy Snake," a curio modeled after the leviathan "Voracity." Originally shaped like a snake, but the more it eats, the more it transforms into a donut. She forgot it on top of a volcano, but two system hours later, she spotted it immediately... Because the volcano was gone. The detention room door swung open, revealing a woman leaning against the door frame, gazing helplessly at the graffiti covering every inch of the walls. "Playtime's over, Silver Wolf." The girl tossed aside her marker with boredom. "I've already figured out what I'm doing next time. You can't keep me locked up." "Do you have any idea how much chaos you caused messing around with that cartridge?" "Oh, I remember." A sly grin spread across the girl's face. "You mean how the Cosmic Big Lotto spit out a million jackpots and Oswaldo himself had to shut the whole thing down?" "Or wait, are you talking about when the Harmonic Strings hit three wrong notes in a row? Totally unprecedented." "You're not still on about Screwllum, are you? That was all fake. I didn't actually disassemble him into spare parts, okay? And even if I did, it's not like I'm scared of him getting payback." The woman shook her head. "I'm talking about you. You nearly didn't make it. That cartridge was controlling you." The girl turned her head away. "Don't need you worrying about me... Next time, I'll just come up with some new tricks." >>> "ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" has logged out of "Cosmos" >>> "ID: Silver Wolf" has logged in to "Cosmos"

The girl has an "achievement wall," on which she awards herself a digital badge every time she hits a goal. By now, her achievements are too numerous to count... Achievement: "Solo Maxxing" Description: Become a living LEGEND in Punklorde Status: Completed Player Review: "For me, the hardest part wasn't surviving. It was staying in Punklorde and getting stuck in place." Achievement: "Friend of the IPC" Description: Evenly distribute the IPC's virtual currency among all "Star Cheetah" players Status: Completed Player Review: "They're pinning their year-end accounting discrepancies on us again. 'All for the Amber Lord' they say. More like 'Blame it all on the Stellaron Hunters.' Fine, have it your way. While I'm at it, might as well leak all their dirty laundry too... Hope they raise my bounty even higher." Achievement: "Even Bladie Would Disapprove This" Description: Tank all the attacks from the cyberdemons in Jepella, the city of sins Status: Completed Player Review: "That time in Jepella, I left behind a super cool line in the sky: 'City of sins, I absolve you from being guilty.'" Achievement: "What a Genius" Description: Engage in an information battle against a Genius and obtain an ASSS rating. Status: Completed Player Review: "Is Screwllum a sore loser or what? Using admin privileges to force-disconnect me? Talk about playing dirty!" ... The girl kept smashing her own records, yet at the end of that achievement wall, one badge remained unlit. Engraved on it was a figure similar to her own, but far more flamboyant. It was the vision of some possible future, standing at the peak of Elation, having reached the absolute limit: "Silver Wolf LV.999..." Achievement: "GAME NOT OVER" Status: Incomplete Description: Break through the LV.999 limit and keep this game going forever.

"First off, as a diehard veteran player of 'αWolf,' let me roast the previous game's producer ...Aha's just an Aeon of Elation who doesn't know jack about making games. Forcing me to start with a brutal opening like "Wandering Orphan," grinding experience with that starter cartridge? Talk about a slog! Would it kill you to let me have some fun? Once I survived the opening, things got way better. Becoming the overlord of the Dark Zone Empire, recruiting the Rangers and taverns, and becoming the new master of Device IX, pretty cool stuff. But then the game just... ends? Seriously? What a cop-out! Good thing I knew about your level cap setting, LV.999. Otherwise, making me fight someone who looks exactly like me, and every attack she makes is like saying "Tired. I am so done..." Do you have ANY idea how terrifying that is!? Anyway, back to business! "αWolf Online," which I've been working on for ages, is finally ready to meet you all. To address the pain points mentioned above, I've made the following improvements: 1. Massive Time-Saver! No Grind Required, Level up with One Click Just complete the Stellaron Hunter bootcamp, and you'll unlock the latest form with a single click, gaining brand-new powerful items. Trust me, it'll carry you to victory! 2. New Feature! Experience the Story Your Way When Elation arrives, even the script has to step aside. Play however you want, whenever you want. 3. New Mode! Face a challenge without limit in the Infinite DLC Say goodbye to boring grinding. The best part of the game is always ahead. Hit LV.999? So what? Beyond the peak of Elation, there's an even higher summit waiting. Aha, see that? Now THIS is what a next-gen game looks like. But by choosing αWolf Online, you've chosen "Nightmare Mode." A one-life clear is just the baseline. And every boss is different from the last. So, you're probably wondering: What happens when you fail? Of course, the odds of that happening are basically zero. But if it does, I hope everyone playing this game remembers: This cartridge chronicles an unprecedented hacker's journey. Reaching the end is important, but having more fun along the way is even more important! Next up, get ready for the grand opening of αWolf Online! To all you folks watching, I wish you joy, and I wish myself a blast!" — Message from developer Silver Wolf >>> Administrator "ID: Elio" has granted LV.999 cartridge permissions. >>> "Phantasmoon Games" raid loading... >>> "Script" temporarily disabled. >>> "ID: Silver Wolf LV.999" logging into "Phantasmoon Games"...
